summary.interpretation: Readiness is strongly evidence-gated at the low and middle ranges: lesson completion alone stays below 45%, nominally high Subject A skills without answer evidence stay below 45%, strong fresh Subject A evidence rises substantially but remains below the 80% finishing threshold until Subject B evidence is added, and a fully strong cross-subject profile reaches the high-readiness range. Staling every Subject A question sharply reduces cognitive and memory evidence and lowers the total score. However, because lessons, mocks, skills and Subject B evidence retain substantial weight, this deliberately strong historical profile can still remain at or above the 80% UI threshold even when every Subject A memory item is due. That does not prove a formula bug because the readiness label is not the strict mastery gate; it is a concrete presentation-consistency finding for the next audit.
